messages:
Casey: We need a tiny inline "why-degraded" in the rollout traces. Operators are asking for it.
Rina: Agreed. Keep it enum-only: reason_code, policy_id, severity. No free text.
Omar: Runtime emits reason_code, router appends policy_id. Ingest stores sentinel with sampling.
Casey: UI idea: three compact badges in the trace row + tooltip. Click opens audit playback.
Rina: Sampling suggestion: critical=100%, high=25%, medium=5%, low=1%. Hot window 72h.
ingest-bot: Deployed sentinel-proto v0.3 to staging at 1748010000 :rocket:
Omar: Security: surface only a short header to customers (e.g., X-Redwood-Degraded: kv_miss). Full sentinel stays control-plane only.
Casey: I'll sketch the badge row and open a PR with the enum white-list.
